title: Independent adversarial review of the corrected Story 1.2 lock protocol
summary: Perform a fresh read-only adversarial review of the corrected Story 1.2 mutation-lock acquisition, stale reclamation, incarnation-bound release, and transaction serialization. Actively construct and run hostile multiprocess interleavings for simultaneous and N-way stale reclaim, owner/reclaimer races, former-owner release after successor acquisition, partial metadata, PID-reuse-shaped identity, boot/host mismatch, repeated reclaim, process death during acquire/reclaim/release, and identity changes between observation and action. Inspect for asymmetric or bypass paths and independently rerun every Story 1.2 deterministic gate. Report findings only; do not modify repository files.
